method: breaths by loudness (under -14 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 10 of 12 breaks heard

lines.latin: Auróra cælum púrpurat, Æther resúltat láudibus:
lines.english: The dawn makes the heavens crimson, the sky rings with praises;

lines.latin: Mundus triúmphans júbilat, Horrens avérnus ínfremit:
lines.english: the world exults in triumph, hell shudders and groans,

lines.latin: Rex ille dum fortíssimus, De mortis inférno specu,
lines.english: while that most mighty King, out of death's deep cavern,

lines.latin: Patrum senátum líberum Edúcit ad vitæ jubar.
lines.english: leads forth the company of the Fathers, set free, to the light of life.

lines.latin: Cujus sepúlcrum plúrimo Custóde signábat lapis,
lines.english: He whose tomb a stone had sealed, with many a guard,

lines.latin: Victor triúmphat et suo Mortem sepúlcro fúnerat.
lines.english: rises in triumph as Victor, and buries death in His own tomb.

lines.latin: Sat fúneri, sat lácrimis, Sat est datum dolóribus:
lines.english: Enough of mourning, enough of tears, enough is given to sorrow;

lines.latin: Surréxit exstínctor necis, Clamat corúscans Ángelus.
lines.english: He is risen who has slain death, cries the shining Angel.

lines.latin: Ut sis perénne méntibus Paschále Jesu gáudium,
lines.english: That Thou mayest be, O Jesus, the everlasting Paschal joy of our souls,

lines.latin: A morte dira críminum Vitæ renátos líbera.
lines.english: free those reborn to life from the dread death of sin.

lines.latin: Deo Patri sit glória, Et Fílio, qui a mórtuis
lines.english: To God the Father be glory, and to the Son, who from the dead

lines.latin: Surréxit, ac Paráclito, In sempitérna sǽcula.
lines.english: is risen, and to the Paraclete, for ever and ever.
